text: Long catch-up with Sadia. She starts at the new firm on November 3rd, Monday at 9am sharp, and is already nervous about the commute. Her brother Isaac passed his driving test last week on the second go. Need to text her the night before to wish her luck.
Hugo got the promotion! Team lead from December 1. His wife Astrid is sitting her nursing finals the same week, so the house will be chaos. Must send them both something.

Giulia's audition for the conservatory is Thursday at 2pm. She's been practising four hours a day and barely sleeping. Her mum is driving her down. Remind me to ring her Thursday evening to see how it went.
Pick up dry cleaning tomorrow morning before 10, then post office. Car MOT booked for 10/28 at half 8.

Coffee with Afua and Kofi. Afua is leaving the council after eleven years, last day is Oct 31. Kofi says she's secretly terrified of being bored. They're doing leaving drinks at the Crown that Friday from 6pm. I'm bringing the cake.

Phoebe failed her theory test again, third time. She's gutted and talking about giving up. Her dad offered to pay for lessons but she won't take it. I should check in with her this weekend, maybe take her for a walk with the dog.
Emily mentioned Aneesh has his bar exam results on December 12. He's pretending not to care. Emily is planning a dinner either way.

Lorenzo retired on Friday after 34 years at the depot. Says he's going to get back into fishing and restore the old Vespa. His grandson Milan helped him clear his locker. Don't forget to ask him how the first week of retirement felt.
Jess - new job at the hospital pharmacy, starts Jan 6. Wants to move closer, looking at flats in March.
Niamh's driving test got cancelled because of the snow, rebooked for Feb 11th at 3.40pm. She's annoyed but relieved too. Her boyfriend Abdi has been taking her out in his car every Sunday morning.

Hiroshi called. His daughter has her GCSE mocks starting the 17th, and he's worried she's not revising. Also he's been made redundant, last day November 28. Need to ring him next week and see how he's coping.
Vera is vegan now, apparently since the summer. Loves bouldering and goes three nights a week.
Sorted the car insurance renewal. Dentist moved to Nov 19 at 4:15. Still need to book the flu jab.

Dana and Mabel both started at the bakery on Monday. Dana's on early shifts, 5am, and hates it already. Mabel says the head baker, a guy called Pieter, is lovely but terrifying. They're sharing a car until Dana passes her test in the spring.
Svetlana's PhD viva is 12/4 at 10am! She's so stressed she's stopped eating properly. Her husband Lars is taking the day off. Must send flowers to the department after.
Rana got into the national youth orchestra, second violin. Rehearsals start in January in Leeds. Her little brother Samir is apparently furious about all the attention.
Quick one: Ifeoma's interview at the bank is Wednesday at 11. Text her good luck Tuesday night.

Katarzyna was promoted to head of science, starts after Easter. Her current boss Michael is retiring in April and she's been doing half his job anyway. Her partner Nora says she's been dreaming about timetables. Should get her a nice pen or a planner, she said hers is falling apart.
Marisol has been temping since August and finally got a permanent offer. Said yes on the spot. She starts properly on November 10th.
Tamar's son Milan has his grade 5 piano exam on the 22nd at 1pm. Tamar is more nervous than he is.

Lunch with Hugo, Isaac and Afua. Isaac's starting an apprenticeship with an electrician in January. Afua's thinking of retraining as a midwife, applications close Jan 15. Hugo's still on about his allotment. Fun, should do it again before Christmas.
Need to renew passport before the March trip. Photo booth at the station, Saturday morning.
Sadia's mum had her hip operation on Tuesday, went well. Sadia's back at work tomorrow. Ask after her mum when I see her Thursday.

Pieter Novak (everyone calls him Piet) is leaving the club as treasurer. He's moving to Rotterdam for a job at the port, flying out on June 3rd. Farewell do is May 30 at the clubhouse, 7pm. His wife Giulia is staying behind until their daughter finishes school in July. I'm doing the speech, gulp.
Isaac's driving test is tomorrow morning at 8:20. Wish him luck tonight.
Got my results! Passed the accountancy module. Next exam is June 9th, booked already.
Kofi mentioned his sister Afua finally passed her driving test. Took her five attempts. She's bought a tiny red Fiat.
Emily's first day at the school was rough, kids ran rings round her. She's teaching year 9 maths. Head of department is supportive at least. Text her Friday to see how the rest of the week went.

Aneesh's wedding was meant to be in May but it's off. He and Jess split up in September. He's thrown himself into work and is going for the senior engineer role, interview on the 14th at 2pm. I need to message him the morning of.
Afua's retirement party moved from Friday to Saturday 11/8, 3pm, her daughter's place. Bring a card, everyone's chipping in for a garden bench.
Phoebe's driving test is 1/22 at half 10, booked it while I was with her. Her nan's lending her the Micra. She's a nervous wreck about roundabouts.
Hiroshi Yilmaz from the running club is taking over as coach in the new year. He's training for Berlin, race is September 27. His knee is still dodgy though.

Bumped into Lorenzo and his wife Svetlana at the market. Their granddaughter Mabel has her A level results on August 13th and wants to do vet med at Bristol. Lorenzo's very proud. Svetlana is knitting everyone jumpers for Christmas again, hint hint, I asked for a green one.
Lars mentioned his boss is retiring at the end of the month and Lars might get her job. He's not counting on it. His dog Biscuit had surgery on Monday and is recovering at home with a cone on.
Niamh starts uni in Glasgow next September. Studying architecture. Her parents are already sad.
Abdi got sacked from the warehouse, no notice. He's job hunting and pretty low. Should call him this week, and send him the link to the job at Dana's place.
Dentist Thursday at 3pm. Haircut Saturday. Bin day moved to Tuesday.
Vera passed her black belt grading on Saturday! Her husband Michael filmed the whole thing. Her next grading isn't for two years.

Long call with Tamar. Her new role at the charity starts on April 7th, they're giving her a team of six. Her husband Kofi is going part time to cover school runs. She mentioned her old manager Rana was quietly pushed out last month and she feels guilty about leaving. Their son starts reception in September too. A lot going on. Remind me to send a good luck card before the 7th.
Samir has his citizenship test on 3/19, Thursday morning. Studying the history bits with his cousin.
Ifeoma didn't get the bank job. She's okay about it, said the commute would have killed her. Applying for something at the university instead.
Mrs Haddad next door is retiring from the GP surgery on Dec 19. Thirty years as practice nurse. Should organise something from the street, maybe a card everyone signs.
Katarzyna mentioned her driving test was yesterday and she passed. She's taking her mum Nora to the coast to celebrate on Sunday.

Marisol and her girlfriend Jess are both starting new jobs on the same day, January 5th at 8am. Marisol at the hotel, Jess at the airport. They're doing a takeaway the Friday before to celebrate. I'm invited.
Reminder to self: interview prep for Monday 2pm. Print CV, iron the blue shirt.
Hugo's daughter has her theory test on 10/30 at 4pm. He's been quizzing her at dinner. He says she's coeliac so his whole family eats gluten free now.
Nora's son Isaac got a first! Graduation is July 18. Nora wants to throw a garden party the weekend after. Ask her what he'd like as a present, she said maybe a decent watch.

Michael Johnson, Uncle Mike to everyone, has his last shift on the buses on Friday. Forty-one years. His son Lorenzo is driving the last route with him. Uncle Mike says he'll finally take up golf. Get him a card and some balls.
Saw Dr Banerjee for the follow up, back in 6 weeks. Also need to book the eye test.

Giulia is struggling at the new job, the manager keeps moving her targets and she's crying most evenings. She has a review on the 21st at 9:30. Her sister Sadia says she should just quit. Need to check in with her before the review and again after.
Kofi passed his HGV test! Starting with the haulage firm Monday. Said the exam was the hardest thing he's ever done.
Svetlana's grandson Hugo got into the choir school, starts in September. Audition was on May 2nd.
Afua said Emily (Em) is going for head of year. Interviews are the week of March 10th. Em doesn't think she'll get it because she's only been there two years.
Phoebe passed!!! First time. Text her congrats and ask how the roundabouts went.

Dana's mum is starting a new job at the library on June 2nd, first job in twenty years since the kids. Dana says she's excited but also very nervous about the computer system. Her dad thinks it's brilliant.

Big week for the Ahmeds. Abdi has his final exams starting Monday the 16th, nine papers over three weeks. His dad Samir is retiring from the taxi firm on the 20th at noon, last shift. And their cat Pepper needs her teeth out on Thursday morning. Abdi's mum is doing all of it single-handed. I said I'd drop off dinner on Wednesday. I should ask Abdi how the first paper went.
Rana's results day is August 20th, she needs AAB for Edinburgh. Her mum's planning a trip to Italy either way.
Errands: council tax direct debit, return parcel, buy a birthday card. Gym Wednesday 7am.

Lars and Astrid are moving to Oslo for Astrid's new job, she starts there on 2/1. Lars is still looking for work out there. Astrid loves cross country skiing so she's thrilled. Must arrange a goodbye dinner before the end of January.
Niamh mentioned that her grandad Pieter has started volunteering at the railway museum since retiring. He loves it, goes every Tuesday.
